title: Senior Specialist Global QMS
description:
More than one million people in the United States today are fighting blood cancer. While a traditional allogeneic stem cell transplant has been the best hope for many, the transplant itself can prove fatal or lead to serious conditions, such as graft vs. host disease. Orca Bio is a commercial-stage biotechnology company redefining the transplant process by developing next-generation cell therapies with the goal of providing significantly better survival rates with dramatically fewer risks. With our purified, high-precision cell therapies we hope to not only replace patients' blood and immune systems with healthy ones, but also restore their lives.


The Senior Specialist, Global QMS will help implement Orca Bioâs global quality management system across all sites. This role will support and lead the internal audit program, supplier management program, and inspection readiness. This role will support the growth and expansion of the global quality program to support manufacturing of our cell therapy products. You will help establish, implement and maintain the audit program across Orca Bio sites to ensure compliance with GxP and regulatory expectations. Your role will support Orca Bios commercial readiness and ongoing clinical programs by managing and facilitating audits, resolving supplier-related quality issues and interacting with quality management teams at the site levels to ensure consistent application of quality systems across the organization.

\n


Responsibilities:
  • Plan, schedule and execute internal audits across all sites and functions in accordance with the internal audit program.
  • Develop audit agenda, conduct interviews, review processes and generate audit reports.
  • Support the global Quality Management Review (QMR) process, ensuring timely data collection, analysis, and reporting to senior leadership.
  • Support the supplier qualification and management program, including risk assessments, supplier audits, and ongoing monitoring to ensure compliance with GxP requirements.
  • Drive global inspection management activities, ensuring cross-functional and site readiness for FDA, EMA, and other health authority inspections.
  • Provide oversight and guidance to site QMR administrators ensuring consistent quality system implementation across all Orca Bio sites.
  • Establish and monitor global QMS key performance indicators (KPIs), oversee trending of quality metrics, and ensure data-driven insights are used to improve quality systems and performance.

description:
**This position is based in Germany with hybrid or remote working options. Applicants must hold a valid work/residence permit for the respective location.**

Chaos is a leading global software company that provides world-class visualization and design solutions, empowering creative minds to bring ideas to life.

For over twenty years, Chaos has developed innovative technologies serving multiple industries, including architecture and design, media and entertainment, and product e-commerce. Chaosâ solutions help architects, designers, VFX artists/animators, and other creative professionals share ideas, optimize workflows, and create immersive experiences.

Headquartered in Karlsruhe, Germany, Chaos is a global company with offices in 11 cities worldwide. In 2022, Chaos and Enscape merged, bringing together two industry-leading companies into one. Role Overview

The Team Lead, Education Sales leads the Education sales team and owns the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for the Education segment, covering both University and Student markets. The role is responsible for driving new institution and student customer acquisition, growing ARR within the existing base, and reducing churn across both segments. Reporting to the Sr. Director GTM Strategy & Transformation, this role requires a commercially driven sales leader with a hands-on approach, a track record of owning segment revenue end-to-end, and the ability to coach and develop a team while remaining personally active in deals. The role operates with a high degree of autonomy and suits someone who wants to build and scale a team rather than maintain one.

Main Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop the Education sales team, setting clear individual performance expectations, coaching from the front, and stepping into deals directly where needed to support pipeline and attainment targets.

  • Own and scale a proactive, discovery-led outbound motion to win new institution and student customers, continuously refining outreach cadence and qualification criteria.

  • Drive expansion and retention within the existing student and institution customer base, identifying and executing initiatives that grow ARR and reduce churn.

  • Own ARR and pipeline growth within the University segment through relationship-led, direct sales to institutions, tracking key performance metrics and diagnosing and correcting underperformance.

  • Own ARR and seat growth within the Student segment, which runs as a low-touch, digital-first purchase journey rather than a traditional sales motion; partner with the Ecommerce team to continuously optimize the online funnel, conversion rates, and pricing experience.

  • Own accurate pipeline forecasting and attainment reporting for the Education business, providing reliable visibility into performance for sales reviews and senior leadership.

  • Partner with RevOps, Marketing, Product, and Ecommerce to ensure Education-specific campaigns, content, and product feedback are prioritised and executed effectively.



Required Experience

  • At least 5 years of sales experience within a SaaS or technology environment, including demonstrated experience leading a sales team with direct accountability for team performance and revenue outcomes.

  • Proven track record of owning a direct sales territory or segment end-to-end, from pipeline generation through closed, retained revenue.

  • Experience managing and influencing a low-touch, digital or ecommerce-led purchase journey (funnel, conversion, pricing) is a strong advantage.

  • Previous experience in Architecture, Education, EdTech, or a related vertical is an advantage, but not required.

Required Skills

  • Takes full ownership of commercial outcomes: builds pipeline, closes deals, and drives team performance without waiting to be directed.

  • Leads by example in the field: comfortable coaching team members through live deals and personally engaging in high-priority opportunities where it makes a difference.

  • Translates ARR and revenue data into clear, defensible strategy, is able to identify where performance is off track, diagnose the root cause, and act on it.

  • Communicates with credibility at senior level: presents team results, forecasts, and strategic needs clearly to VP-level and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Able to build effective working relationships and collaborate cross-functionally across Ecommerce, RevOps, and Marketing: driving digital funnel and conversion improvements for the Student segment without direct authority.

  • Operates effectively with high autonomy in a fast-moving environment: sets own priorities, creates momentum without close direction, and holds a consistently high personal bar for execution and results.

  • Familiarity with MEDDICC or a similar sales qualification framework is an advantage.

We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

The Solutions Delivery Manager is responsible for ensuring Benchling solution development, coverage, efficacy, quality, and enablement across the Customer Experience team. You have spent 7+ years designing complex digital products, ideally including SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or similarly sophisticated product experiences, and are ready to shape product direction, design standards and team culture across one or more product pillars.

  • Experience influencing design direction for high-impact product areas, systems, platforms or pillars, not only individual features or flows.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, data partners, customer-facing teams, senior stakeholders and other designers.

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas, lead critiques and workshops and persuade through rationale, evidence and craft.

  • Passion for improving team operations, design standards, processes, tools, documentation and better ways for teams to work.

We are seeking engineers to build platform infrastructure at the intersection of computational science, AI systems, and software engineering.

Our mission is to discover and commercialize transformative physics breakthroughs at scale with artificial superintelligence, safely, verifiably, and for broad public benefit.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

This Role Is Not For

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Language

Interview Process

title: Surveyor I
description:
Job Description

The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.
  • Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Physical Requirements:

  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. Weâre at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Equal Opportunity

ABS Bureau is committed to the equal employment opportunity of its employees and prohibits discrimination against any employee or qualified applicant based on race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status or veteran status, or other non-work-related characteristics that may be protected under the law of the Federal Government or specific state employment laws.

ABS and Affiliated Companies (ABS) will not pay a fee to any third-party agency without a valid ABS Master Service Agreement (MSA) authorized and signed by Human Resources. Any resume, CV, application, or other forms of candidate submission provided to any employee of ABS without a valid MSA on file will be considered property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.

Other

title: Why do you want this new job
description:
No matter which side of the table youâve sat during interviews, youâve probably heard this question: âWhy do you want this new job?â

In the recent past, Iâve interviewed a few candidates and heard the following answers so far:

  • Iâm not learning much on the current job after itâs been 2-4 years.
  • Iâm looking for something that offers better work-life balance.
  • Iâm not really looking for a job. The recruiters got in touch and I thought Iâd discuss.
  • Iâm looking for more challenging work.

All of the above are valid answers. I think thereâs another perfectly valid answer that candidates seldom mention probably due to the gravity of the interview room situation. Iâve interviewed over a hundred candidates across different companies and am yet to find anyone that mentions: I am not happy with my current salary and benefits compared to my skills

Back to topic of answers. So, when someone answers that they are not learning new things on the job, obviously, youâd be curios to know why and how they have tried to change things. Unfortunately, most candidates simply mention that they are doing repeat work and thereâs not much to learn doing the same thing over and over again. This is where I start feeling a little uneasy. However, I understand that itâs a true statement. If youâre in a similar situation, hereâs some suggestion: read books, and write code based on what youâve read. Then, you can tell a much convincing story that, Iâve forced myself to learn new things and hereâs some proof, but I really want to apply the newly learned skills outside the scope of the âhello worldâ skills.

About work-life balance, I totally hear you. And if your current job doesnât suit what you need out of your life, itâs a perfectly valid reason to look for new opportunities. However, make sure youâre able to clearly set the expectation with your potential employer about what work-life balance means for you. For example, if you canât work over 40 hours a week, or must work from home one-two days a week, itâs best to discuss this even before an interview starts to ensure youâre a good match with the employer.

If you showed up at in interview just because a recruiter got in touch, Iâd say introspect first. Itâs possible that on our subconcious mind you have expectations that the potential of the new job offers you something that you donât get at the current job. So, instead of a passive asnwer that the you simply acted based on the recruiterâs invite, itâs much convincing to see if you can lay down one or two things that you expect from the new job that you donât get at the current job.

About looking for more challenge, it sounds like a cliche unless you can share examples of work that is of challenging to you. May be you like the challenge of using more complicated algorithms, may be you like dealing with a lot of data, may be you like supporting production emergencies, but thereâs gotta be something that you can explicitly mention as challenging. It helps employers to understand if theyâre able to provide you with enough challenge on the job.

Finally, if youâre looking for a new job because the current job isnât paying upto the level of your skills and contributions, make sure to communicate it clearly as well. With salaries and benefits, I find it much easier to work with people that know the actual $ figure thatâll make them happy instead of beating around the bush to create confusions all around. Just be confident and tell what makes you happy. If the employer can afford it, most likely theyâll want to get you onboard as a happy employee. If they canât afford it, theyâll do their best. The key here is to be explicit about what you want and be sure and confident about it.

As long as you are able to justify why you want the new job, theyâll be quite accommodating.

title: Head of Security
description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send payoutsâgift cards and moneyâto anyone, anywhere, instantly. We're trusted by 20,000+ organizations, from startups to giants like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way, to reach millions of recipients worldwide.

We're profitable and growing without outside investors. We're fully remote, with a high-documentation, low-meeting culture that leaves more time for the work that mattersâand for your life outside it. Our employee NPS sits in the high 80s.

We move billions of dollars through our systems. That makes security existential, and it's why we're making our first dedicated security hire.

About The Role

You'll be our first Head of Security. There's already a real foundation hereâbug bounty, pen tests, automated code and configuration scanning on the production and code side, phishing simulations on the people side. Youâll add to it across access and identity, SecOps and monitoring, incident response, vendor security, employee security practices, and policy. You'll own the whole posture.

This is a player-coach role. Early on, you'll do the scoping and the hands-on work yourself; this is not a role where you direct from above. As the work demands it, we're fully prepared to build a team hereâand we're looking to you to define what that team should be and when.

You'll report to the VP of Engineering, Tremendous' most senior technical leader. We've deliberately placed security with Engineering so you're set up to drive real implementation fastâembedded with the people whose work you're securing, not siloed in a compliance function. As the security function matures, we'll revisit this.

What You'll Do

  • Own Tremendous' security posture end-to-end, partnering with our engineering team on production infrastructure and code security.
  • Assess where we have gaps, prioritize them, and tackle our highest-leverage gaps first. Weâll have opinions, but you own the prioritization and implementation.
  • Treat incident response as core, not afterthought. We may not be able to prevent a breach, but your job is making sure it's small, contained, and that we know exactly what to do.
  • Drive security as a cultural shift across the companyâintroducing controls incrementally, working with teams rather than over them. "Yes, and," not "no."
  • Lead our AI-security posture. We invest heavily in AI tooling; your job is to manage that risk and enable it, not to ban it.
  • Define when and how to staff up the security function, and hire your own team.

What You'll Bring

  • Real, hands-on security experience at a company that scaledâideally as an early security hire who grew with the business through high growth.
  • Deep experience in at least one core security domainâproduct/production security, security operations, or access/identity and policyâwith enough range to reason across the others. You defined the security posture, not just executed someone elseâs playbook.
  • An engineer's mindset. You reach for code to solve problems and can read our codebase and understand our infrastructure (Ruby on Rails; TypeScript + React; PostgreSQL; Google Cloud). You won't write much day-to-day, but you're not lost in the code.
  • Judgment over checklists. You can explain the actual risk of a given decision, hold a firm line where it matters, and give ground where "best practice" doesn't apply to us or real business need pulls the other way. You can hold your own in a debate about whether to open up broad data access for AI tooling.
  • Bedside manner. You drive hard change by bringing the team around to your point of view, rather than just telling them no. Engineers and the rest of the company want to work with you.
  • Experience building or co-building a small security team is a plus.
  • Fintech, payments, or regulated-industry experience is a plus.

What's Cool About The Role

  • You define the function. First security leader, with the budget for the required tools and team.
  • A real mandate. The push for this hire comes straight from the founders.
  • We invest in your tools. Everyone has a $5k/month budget for AI tools. Use it.
  • Competitive pay and equity. Base salary $250,000â$330,000, plus meaningful equity.
  • Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas.
  • Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook.

Compensation Range: $250K - $330K

title: Data Analyst Assistant
description:
About the role
 The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
 Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.

What you will do
  • Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
  • Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
  • Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
  • Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
  • Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
  • Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
  • Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.
  • Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports.


What we are looking for
  • A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors.
  • Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English.
  • Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors.
  • Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review.
  • A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.


How we work
 We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

What the role offers

  • Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates.
  • Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.
  • The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote.
  • Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health.

title: Regional Sales Manager
description:
Company Information

CSWâs Engineered Building Solutions segment manufactures custom architectural building components and innovative firestopping and smoke-rated products that help protect people. Safety and code compliance are top of mind for architects, engineers and contractors. Our purposeful brands combine functionality with aesthetically pleasing designs for the construction, refurbishment, and modernization of buildings.â¯Our brands include Balco, Greco Architectural Metal Products, and Smoke Guard.

Position Summary

Balco is seeking a dynamic, motivated, and results-driven Regional Sales Manager to lead and grow sales of our architectural product lines across the Western Half of the United States. This is a high-impact leadership role for a sales professional who thrives in the architectural building products space and is energized by building teams, driving growth, and influencing complex construction projects from design through installation.

The RSM will lead a network of direct sales professionals and independent manufacturer representatives while serving as a key market ambassador for Balcoâs portfolio of architectural engineered products for the construction industry. Categories include expansion joint systems, stair nosings, entrance mats & grids, photoluminescent egress systems, etc. The ideal candidate combines strong sales leadership with technical acumen to guide product selection based on project-specific conditions, ensuring Balco solutions are specified and installed successfully in competitive bid environments. This role combines strategic leadership, hands-on selling and technical support, and rigorous performance management to deliver profitable growth and exceptional customer experiences.

Responsibilities

  • Drive year-over-year revenue growth to meet or exceed sales budgets across assigned territories and product lines.
  • Build, coach, and lead a high-performing sales organization consisting of direct sales employees and independent manufacturer representatives, setting clear goals and driving accountability across both groups.
  • Provide technical guidance and support to sales team members and customers, including analyzing project conditions, recommending appropriate Balco products (e.g., expansion joint systems, stair nosings, photoluminescent egress markings), and assisting with submittals and specifications.
  • Develop and implement competitive strategies to increase Balco specification rates and market share, including targeted initiatives with architects, contractors, and distributors.
  • Maintain deep knowledge of the competitive landscape, including products, pricing, and market dynamics, to win specification and project opportunities.
  • Track and report on sales performance, market trends, and competitive activities using CRM tools; prepare weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports.â¯
  • Deliver sales and product knowledge presentations to architects, contractors, trade groups, and other stakeholders.
  • Lead and support complex negotiations to secure profitable, strategic opportunities.
  • Partner closely with Customer Service, Technical Services, and internal leadership to ensure outstanding execution and customer satisfaction.
  • Establish clear expectations, regularly track, and review performance metrics, proactively address gaps through coaching and development plans, and recognize/reward wins and best practices.
  • Expand and strengthen relationships with existing customers, contractors, distributors, architects, design engineers, and other key influencers across the full sales territory.
  • Ensure compliance with all safety requirements, including OSHA 10 standards for jobsite visits.
  • Travel to meet customers, prospects, sales team members, attend trade shows, and other industry events. Travel expectations ~30%.â¯

Qualifications (Knowledge & Skills)

  • Hands-on experience with expansion joint systems, stair nosings, photoluminescent egress, or similar specialty products strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated track record of building and leading sales teams to consistently meet or exceed aggressive growth targets in competitive markets.
  • Strong executive presence with excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Highly relationship-driven with the ability to influence across multiple stakeholders and decision-makers.
  • Strategic thinker with an entrepreneurial mindset and a strong customer-first approach.
  • Skilled negotiator comfortable managing complex, multi-party sales scenarios.
  • Confident presenter capable of delivering impactful sales and technical presentations.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and CRM/order management systems, including Salesforce.
  • Able to communicate effectively and professionally with team members and customers verbally and in writing.
  • Able to complete work accurately and on time.
  • Able to work collaboratively with direct team members, or across departments, and work independently as needed.
  • Able to effectively lead a team by providing direction, measuring quality of work, giving feedback, and managing performance.
  • Candidates who apply for positions that require driving must have a valid U.S. driverâs license and clean driving record. An MVR and proof of insurance will be required as part of the pre-employment background check process.

Education

  • High school diploma required.
  • Bachelorâs degree in Business, Marketing, or related field preferred.

Experience

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in sales, with at least 2 years in a leadership role.

Work Environment

  • Field: This position requires the ability to visit construction sites from time to time and utilize the required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), i.e.: hard hat, eye/face protection, hearing protection, steel toes, etc.

title: Regional Flight Operations Support Manager
description:
About Wing:

Wing offers drone delivery as a safe, fast, and sustainable solution for last mile logistics. Consumer appetites for on-demand services are increasing, but current delivery methods are inefficient, costly, and contribute to road accidents and air pollution. Wingâs fleet of highly automated delivery drones can transport small packages directly from businesses to homes on-demand, in minutes. We design, build, and operate our aircraft, and offer drone delivery services on two continents. Our technology is designed to be easy to integrate into existing delivery and logistics networks, offering a scalable drone delivery solution for a broad range of businesses. Wing is a part of Google's parent company, Alphabet, and our mission is to create the preferred means of delivery for the planet. If you're ready to do the greatest work of your life, come join us.

About the Role:

Wing is looking for a Regional Flight Operations Support Manager to join our Flight Operations team. This role is based remotely in the United States.

What Youâll Do:

  • People Leadership & Development: Directly manage, mentor, and develop a team of Flight Operations Support Coordinators. Set clear expectations, provide regular coaching and deliver actionable feedback to raise the bar for team performance.
  • Oversee Regional Vendor Strategy: Serve as the primary regional point of contact for Vendor leadership to manage contract adherence and optimize the deployment of Ground Support and Visual Observer crews.
  • Operational Systems Governance: Oversee regional utilization of workforce management tools (e.g., Deputy, ServiceNow) and Google Workspace (gSuite), ensuring the team maintains high standards for data integrity and consistent application of scheduling protocols.
  • Financial & Administrative Oversight: Function as the primary approver for team timesheets, expense reports, and regional travel. Simplify complex regional budget issues into actionable steps to solve problems alongside peer managers.
  • Long-Range Capacity Planning: Forecast regional staffing requirements based on projected flight volumes, partnering with internal stakeholders to proactively adjust vendor headcount and recruitment pipelines.
  • SOP Development & Training: Lead the creation and maintenance of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for site logistics and crew readiness; ensure consistent "Wing Standards" and health and safety policy compliance across the region.
  • Cross-Functional Integration: Actively connect your team with cross-functional partners (Maintenance, Training, Community Affairs) to promote shared goals and enable effective teamwork toward Wingâs most important targets. Represent Wing by engaging with public and government visitors to support regional outreach activities.

What Youâll Need:

  • 5+ years of experience in aviation operations, logistics, or workforce management, including proven experience as a people manager leading distributed teams.
  • Valid Driver's License
  • Demonstrated Leadership: Proven ability to set priorities, provide coaching, and manage the performance of direct reports in high-pressure environments.
  • Strategic Problem Solving: Ability to independently manage project planning and solve problems of moderate complexity with high ambiguity.
  • Scheduling Flexibility: Willing and able to work 5 days/week, including weekends and/or holidays as business needs dictate.
  • Operational Expertise: 2+ years of direct experience in Commercial Drone operations (Part 107/135). Active 14 CFR Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate required.
    • Physical Requirements: Ability to perform moderate physical work and maintain attention in outdoor environments for extended periods, including the ability to lift and transport equipment
  • Communication Excellence: Proven ability to manage external vendor relationships and influence internal partners through clear, data-backed communication.

title: Data Entry Administrator
description:
About PulseMediaNL

PulseMediaNL is a forward-thinking digital media company committed to delivering high-quality content, innovative marketing solutions, and exceptional customer experiences. We value accuracy, efficiency, collaboration, and continuous improvement. As our team grows, we are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Data Entry Administrator to support our daily operations by maintaining accurate and reliable data across multiple platforms.

Position Overview

The Data Entry Administrator is responsible for accurately entering, updating, verifying, and maintaining company data while ensuring the highest standards of quality and confidentiality. This role requires excellent attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment. The successful candidate will help ensure that business records remain complete, accurate, and accessible, contributing directly to operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Accurately enter data into company databases, spreadsheets, and internal management systems.
  • Review and verify information for completeness, accuracy, and consistency before submission.
  • Update existing records with new information while maintaining data integrity.
  • Identify and correct errors, inconsistencies, or duplicate entries.
  • Organize and maintain digital files, records, and documentation.
  • Perform routine data quality checks and audits.
  • Generate reports and summaries as requested by management.
  • Assist with importing and exporting data between various software platforms.
  • Maintain confidential information in accordance with company policies and applicable privacy regulations.
  • Collaborate with internal departments to obtain missing or updated information.
  • Prioritize tasks to meet deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
  • Support administrative projects and perform additional data-related tasks as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent; an associate's or bachelor's degree is an advantage.
  • Previous experience in data entry, administrative support, or office administration preferred.
  • Excellent typing skills with a high level of accuracy.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing error-free work.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and Word.
  • Experience using Google Workspace, including Google Sheets and Google Docs.
  • Comfortable learning and using new software and database systems.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote work environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with CRM or ERP software.
  • Familiarity with database management systems.
  • Knowledge of data privacy and information security best practices.
  • Experience working remotely in a professional environment.
  • Basic analytical and problem-solving skills.

Key Skills

  • Data entry accuracy
  • Time management
  • Organization
  • Attention to detail
  • Communication
  • Problem-solving
  • Computer literacy
  • Multitasking
  • Confidentiality
  • Team collaboration

What We Offer

  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Flexible working schedule where applicable.
  • Paid time off and company holidays.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
  • Supportive and collaborative team culture.
  • Ongoing training and skill development.
  • Performance recognition and advancement opportunities.
  • Access to modern digital collaboration tools.

Success in This Role

The ideal candidate consistently delivers accurate work, meets deadlines, maintains confidentiality, communicates effectively with colleagues, and demonstrates a proactive approach to improving data quality and administrative processes.

Equal Opportunity Employer

PulseMediaNL is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees are treated with respect and provided equal opportunities.

If you are a detail-oriented professional who enjoys working with data and thrives in a remote environment, we encourage you to apply and become part of the PulseMediaNL team.

title: Robot Learning Engineer
description:
Why this role is exciting

Rohlik is the leading Central European e-grocer. More than a million customers buy their groceries from us through Rohlik.cz, Knuspr.de, Kifli.hu, Gurkerl.at and Sezamo.ro, choosing from over 17,000 items, delivered within a couple of hours in 15-minute windows.

We are building the autonomous grocer. Maia, our AI assistant, already talks to customers and builds their orders; agents are moving into our buying and logistics; vision models are learning to watch quality. The next frontier is physical: robots taking over more and more of the work in our fulfilment centres, until fresh food moves from producers to households at a cost nobody else can match.

We are setting out to record how our own people handle groceries and to turn those recordings into a training corpus for manipulation policies. Our warehouses already log what happened on every pick and every quality check, so the recordings can carry labels most datasets never get. Making that hold is part of the job.

You decide what makes an hour of footage trainable — before we bank hundreds of them.

What you will own and deliver

  • The capture spec. Cameras, mounts, calibration, and what disqualifies an episode. You write it before we buy the fleet and enforce it after. When the spec and the floor disagree, you go to the floor and find out which one is wrong.

  • Ground truth. Hand pose is the signal that transfers from human video to robot policies, and warehouse reality — work gloves, occlusion, cold halls — is exactly where the published models struggle. You own how we measure that and how we close the gap.

  • The evaluation harness. The corpus only counts if a policy can train on it. You build the harness that decides which hours make the bank, and you hold the trainability bar as the volume grows.

  • The first training runs. Once hours bank, you post-train open robot-learning models on our data and run the first task evaluations.

  • Judgment before spend. The field moves monthly. You read what is published, reproduce the claims we depend on, and steer our capture before the money is spent, not after.

The scope

This is a seat on a small, newly created team: an operations lead who runs capture on the floor, a data engineer who owns the pipeline, and you: the machine-learning voice in the room. This is not a research-scientist role, and no publication record is required. The job is to make a corpus trainable and to train the first policies on it.

What we are looking for

  • PyTorch, and computer vision with real 3D geometry. Camera calibration, pose estimation, SLAM fundamentals. You have debugged an extrinsic calibration at least once in your life and know why it drifted.

  • You can read a paper and reproduce it. Our pipeline is assembled from published work, and your job is knowing which claims survive contact with a chilled warehouse hall.

  • You know what policies train on. Familiar with the current robot-learning stack and policy classes well enough to know what the training side will demand of the data before the data exists.

  • AI is how work gets done here. Our engineers use Claude Code and Devin daily, and we expect you to direct agents for the unglamorous parts — harness code, data plumbing, reproduction scripts — while keeping the quality bar exactly where it was.

  • Particularly relevant. Hand-pose estimation or egocentric video in production; multi-camera rigs and time sync; experience post-training robot-learning models; ROS 2.

What success looks like in 90 days

You have written the capture spec and we set up the first rigs against it. Your pilot gates have numbers, the first hours have passed your harness, and you can tell the people who sign the budget, with data, what the next hundred hours should look like.

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

As Harvey scales its pre-sales function across EMEA, we are hiring a Legal Engineer Manager to lead and grow the team in Munich. This role exists to provide senior leadership and strategic direction to a team of Legal Engineers who sit at the heart of Harvey's commercial motion - bringing legal credibility, product expertise, and consultative support to law firm and in-house prospects.

Harvey’s Legal Engineers are skilled lawyers from top-tier law firms who apply their legal experience to ensure that current and prospective customers understand how Harvey’s solutions enhance specific day-to-day workflows, working alongside Harvey’s Account Executives to support all aspects of our sales strategy. Legal Engineers build consultative relationships with law firm partners and associates and in-house attorneys at private equity firms and Fortune 500 companies, becoming trusted advisors on how Harvey’s AI solutions can make them more effective.

Similar to the way Solutions Architects secure the “technical win” in the sales process, Legal Engineers secure the “legal win” by performing in-depth customer discovery and education on Harvey’s solutions through targeted meetings and demos that resonate with the customer’s day-to-day workflows specific to their legal practice area.

Legal Engineers utilize their experience practicing law and their legal mindset to ask thoughtful questions to understand the needs of law firm and in-house attorneys, develop credibility, and then partner with Account Executives to educate them on Harvey’s value via large and small group sessions as well as one-to-one conversations.

What You'll Do

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Legal Engineers, setting clear performance expectations and building a high-trust, high-output team culture

  • Own the quality and consistency of Harvey's pre-sales legal engineering function, ensuring demos, discovery conversations, and deal support are delivered to the highest standard

  • Partner closely with Account Executives and GTM leadership to prioritise pipeline, develop deal strategy, and support conversion on complex or strategic opportunities

  • Engage with lawyers at prospective customers to understand and address their workflow challenges

  • Collaborate with Product and Marketing to ensure the team's field insights are feeding into positioning, roadmap, and go-to-market strategy

  • Lead product demonstrations tailored to the context of various law firm practice groups and in-house legal teams, asking questions to validate how Harvey can add value and then showcasing Harvey’s features and benefits relevant to each prospective client’s potential use cases.

  • Act as the “Voice of the Customer,” using your legal perspective to help the broader sales team to develop and implement more effective strategies and synthesize customer feedback for the product team through a legal lens.

  • Must have prior experience managing a team, with a track record of developing talent and driving performance

  • Deep familiarity with legal technology and AI tools, with an ability to quickly develop and demonstrate platform expertise

  • Strong commercial instincts and the ability to engage credibly with senior stakeholders at law firms and in-house legal teams

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with experience running training, workshops, or client-facing product sessions

title: Internship - Founders' Office
description:
about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.

mission

As the Founders' Office Intern at telli, you'll work right alongside the founding team across finance, legal, ops, and special projects. You'll have a front-row seat to how an early-stage AI company operates and a very hands-on role in keeping things running and moving fast.

what you’ll do:

  • help us build the operational backbone behind telli's growth

  • take on special projects, driving initiatives forward by coordinating stakeholders and keeping everything on track

  • support with finance operations by maintaining reports, chasing invoices, and managing payment flow

what makes you a great fit:

  • you love solving problems and figuring things out on your own

But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.

about the role

As Deployment Strategist you own end-to-end deployment for a portfolio of telli customers. You lead complex, high-stakes implementations from signature to first production call, bringing customers live fast and setting them up to succeed as telli scales.

Once sales closes a customer, you take over. You scope the use case, build and tune the voice agent, handle telephony and integrations, run UAT with the customer, and drive them to first production call. Your main goal is to get customers to a well implemented Voice Agent setup covering their usecase, showing them the value of automated call operations.

You also build the systems and playbooks that make deployments faster and more repeatable as the customer base grows.

You own a portfolio of deployments and a target on time-to-value and pilot conversion, working alongside product, engineering, sales, and success as telli scales to €10M ARR by end of 2026.

Berlin Mitte – Hybrid, €70.000 – €100.000 Jahresgehalt, 28 Tage Urlaub

WICHTIG: Wer ausschließlich als Freelancer arbeiten will, ist hier falsch.

Du willst nicht nur Richtlinien schreiben, du willst die komplette Sicherheitsarchitektur in der Cloud bauen und verantworten. Du willst nicht nur Berichte abliefern, du willst Audits von ISO 27001 und BSI‑C5 eigenständig bestehen.

Hier geht es nicht um reine Dokumentation, hier geht es um Hands‑On‑Arbeit mit Terraform, AWS und GCP. Hier geht es nicht um einen starren 9‑to‑5‑Job, hier geht es um eine 32‑Stunden‑Option, Equity und direkten Einfluss auf die Gründer.

Ein Berliner HealthTech‑Startup mit rund zehn Mitarbeitenden, das KI‑gestützte Software zur Automatisierung psychotherapeutischer Dokumentation entwickelt. Die Plattform entlastet Therapeuten von administrativen Aufgaben und verbessert die Patientenversorgung. Das Unternehmen positioniert sich als innovativer Anbieter im Schnittfeld von Künstlicher Intelligenz, Gesundheits‑ und Software‑Technologie.

Warum diese Rolle spannend ist

Hohe Verantwortung – End‑to‑End‑Ownership über Security & Compliance.

Technische Hands‑On‑Arbeit – Cloud‑Security und IaC mit Terraform.

Stabiles Vollzeit‑Umfeld mit 32‑Stunden‑Option.

Equity‑Beteiligung über VESOP.

Direkter Einfluss – täglicher Kontakt zu Gründern und CTO.

Qualifikation

  • Vollständige Audit‑Ownership von ISO 27001 / BSI‑C5 inklusive erfolgreicher Zertifizierung.
  • Erfahrung mit DevSecOps, Secure SDLC, Threat Modeling und Vulnerability Management.
  • Fließende Deutsch‑ und Englischkenntnisse (C1).
  • Bachelor‑Abschluss oder gleichwertige Qualifikation.
  • Nachweisbare Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering‑Teams in kleinen, async‑first Umgebungen.

Was hier nicht funktioniert

  • Freelancer – keine langfristige Anstellung.
  • Job‑Hopper – häufige Wechsel (< 2 Jahre) sind ein Dealbreaker.
  • Policy‑Only‑Background – keine technische Hands‑On‑Erfahrung.
  • Fehlende Audit‑Erfahrung (ISO 27001/BSI‑C5) – kein Platz für reine Dokumentationsrollen.

Was diese Rolle besonders macht

title: Marketing Manager (m/f/d)
description:
MAOMAO is a fast-growing online supermarket for Asian food, combining e-commerce with content, community and social commerce.

We don't just sell products. We introduce people to new foods, brands, trends and cultures through TikTok, Instagram, livestreams, TikTok Shop, our online shop and our own products.

As MAOMAO continues to grow, we're looking for a Marketing Manager (m/f/d) who wants to take real ownership and help shape the next stage of our marketing.

Aufgaben

What You'll Do

Campaigns & Product Launches

You will plan and coordinate marketing campaigns, promotions, product launches and livestreams from idea to execution.

This includes:

  • developing campaign and launch plans
  • creating timelines, responsibilities and deadlines
  • coordinating content and communication across our channels
  • making sure everyone involved knows what needs to happen and when
  • keeping projects moving and following up on deliverables
  • identifying problems and dependencies early
  • reviewing results and turning learnings into better future campaigns

We are looking for someone who thinks beyond individual tasks and takes responsibility for making the overall project work.

TikTok Shop & Social Commerce

Social commerce is an important part of MAOMAO and an area we want to continue developing.

You will work on:

  • TikTok Shop campaigns and promotions
  • Seller Center and campaign management
  • livestream campaigns and activations
  • product and promotional planning
  • coordination with TikTok and external partners
  • identifying and testing new opportunities in social commerce

Experience with TikTok Shop is a plus, but not a requirement. Curiosity and the ability to learn quickly matter just as much.

Marketing & Content

You will work with our team to develop campaigns and content around Asian food, products, trends and culture.

You will help decide:

  • which products and topics we should focus on
  • how we communicate them to our audience
  • which content formats and channels make sense
  • how campaigns connect across TikTok, Instagram, our online shop, email and other channels

We want someone who doesn't just create marketing, but increasingly understands why something works and how we can make it better.

Team & Project Coordination

Good ideas only matter if they get executed.

You will help coordinate marketing projects across the team, keep track of priorities and deadlines and make sure projects move forward.

Depending on your experience, you may also:

  • coordinate responsibilities within the marketing team
  • improve workflows and processes
  • support and guide other team members
  • take responsibility for larger marketing initiatives
  • help shape marketing priorities together with the founders

There is room to take on more leadership responsibility as both you and MAOMAO grow.

Your Role Can Grow With You

We don't expect one person to be an expert in every area of marketing.

Depending on your experience, strengths and interests, you can gradually take on additional responsibility in areas such as:

Performance & KPIs
Analyzing campaign performance, defining measurable goals and using data to improve marketing decisions.

Marketing Budgets
Managing defined budgets and deciding how resources should be allocated across campaigns and channels.

CRM & Email Marketing
Developing how we communicate with existing customers and improve retention.

What Ownership Means at MAOMAO

Ownership is one of the most important parts of how we work.

It doesn't mean working endless hours or having all the answers.

It means thinking beyond the individual task.

If we are launching a new product in four weeks, we don't want someone who simply waits for a list of things to do.

We want someone who thinks:

What are we trying to achieve? What needs to happen? Which channels should we use? What content do we need? Who owns what? What are the deadlines? What are we missing? What could go wrong? And how will we know whether it worked?

Just as importantly, we value people who think in solutions, not only in problems.

Pointing out that something is not working is useful. But we expect you to go one step further:

What can we do about it? What are the options? What can we test now? What is the fastest reasonable next step?

You should be willing to make informed decisions, experiment, learn from results and iterate quickly rather than waiting for a perfect answer.

Not every idea will work. That is okay.

What matters is that we learn fast, adjust fast and keep moving.

The mindset we're looking for is:

“Here is the problem. Here are the options. Here is what I recommend we try next.”

Qualifikation

Who We're Looking For

We're open to candidates with different backgrounds and levels of experience, but we're looking for someone who has already gained meaningful hands-on marketing experience and is ready to take ownership.

You should:

  • have at least 2 years of relevant experience in marketing, e-commerce, social media, content, campaign management or a related field
  • have fluent German skills (C1 or native-level), as you will be developing marketing for a predominantly German-speaking audience
  • have strong working proficiency in English
  • be highly organized, reliable and proactive
  • take initiative and think ahead
  • be able to turn ideas into structured plans and execution
  • communicate clearly and follow through
  • feel comfortable taking responsibility for outcomes
  • think in solutions rather than simply escalating problems
  • be willing to experiment, test and iterate quickly
  • be comfortable making decisions even when not every answer is obvious
  • have a strong interest in e-commerce, social media and social commerce
  • be comfortable working with data, KPIs and budgets
  • enjoy working in a fast-moving environment
  • be hands-on when needed
  • learn quickly and actively look for ways to improve

Experience in e-commerce, TikTok, TikTok Shop, social media, CRM, performance marketing or campaign management is a plus.

Chinese language skills are a plus but they are NOT a requirement.

Benefits

Benefits

What we offer

  • A central marketing role with a high level of ownership and room to shape how we work
  • Direct collaboration with the founders
  • Founders with backgrounds in venture capital and e-commerce
  • An existing marketing and content team to work with
  • Our own office, warehouse and content setup in Berlin
  • Short decision-making paths and the freedom to actually implement ideas
  • Plenty of room to experiment, test new formats and iterate quickly
  • The opportunity to work at the intersection of e-commerce, social media, TikTok Shop, livestreaming and brand building
  • The opportunity to shape campaigns and launches from idea to execution instead of owning only one small part of the process
  • Clear professional and personal development opportunities, including the potential to take on more leadership responsibility
  • A young, international team with a lot of passion and team spirit
  • Employee discount across our assortment

Interested?

Send us your CV and a short introduction telling us why you want to join MAOMAO and what excites you about this role.

We'd also like you to answer one question:

Tell us about a marketing campaign, project or experiment you took ownership of. What was your goal, what did you do, and what was the result?

It doesn't have to be a huge campaign or a perfect success. We're interested in how you think, how you approach problems and what you learn from the things you try.

One last thing: We don't mind if you use AI to help with your application – we use AI too. But if your application could be sent to 50 other companies by simply replacing the company name, it's probably not for us. Show us why MAOMAO, and show us how you think.

If you want to take ownership, move fast and help us grow a category that has been treated as a niche for far too long, we'd love to hear from you.

Maybe you're the Sriracha to our noodle soup. 🌶️🍜

title: Founding Head of GTM - Cipherscale
description:
The Opportunity: Zero-to-one category creation for AI-Native Zero Trust Access

Cipherscale is building an AI-native Zero Trust access and enforcement plane for humans, software/workloads, and AI agents.

The product doctrine is simple: AI may reason and propose; deterministic policy authorizes; trusted enforcement executes.

We are looking for a commercial founder/operator who can turn that architecture into a category, a repeatable customer problem, real deployments, and initial revenue.

Mission: discover and prove the repeatable commercial truth for Cipherscale - who urgently needs it, what gets them to deploy, what makes them pay, and what causes them to expand.

What You Own

• Own ICP discovery, exclusion criteria, buyer/champion mapping, problem validation, positioning, initial wedge, and design-partner recruitment.

• Personally lead early customer discovery, technical/commercial conversations, executive outreach, design-partner conversion, and initial closing.

• Build an evidence-driven GTM system: every important assumption has supporting/contradicting evidence and a next falsification test.

• Use AI agents aggressively for research, account intelligence, personalization, competitive monitoring, meeting preparation, call synthesis, content, and experiment analysis.

• Work directly with the CEO on category creation and major strategic accounts.

• Work with Product and Engineering to convert recurring customer evidence into governed product inputs - without turning prospect anecdotes into roadmap commitments.

• Define the first repeatable acquisition, deployment, conversion, and expansion motion before scaling a team.

What This Role Is Not

• It is not a traditional marketing leadership job.

• It is not an MQL, impressions, content-calendar, or brand-campaign role.

• It is not a decision to hire SDR, demand-gen, content, and marketing-ops teams before product-market evidence exists.

• It is not ownership of OpenVPN growth. Rod, Head of Growth, owns the established-business growth mandate;

This role is focused on Cipherscale zero-to-one GTM and must collaborate cleanly without duplicating authority.

Important:

  • This is a full-time remote job, and it will be a long-term B2B contract.

  • This can be a permanent employment opportunity for candidates based in Spain, Poland, and Germany.

Our philosophy is that we are a small, close-knit team, and we care deeply about you:

  • Highly competitive salary + Bonus

  • Fully remote work environments.

  • Self-managed time off.


Who We Want

• You have personally helped take a deeply technical B2B security, infrastructure, identity, developer, cloud, or AI

product from near-zero to repeatable initial revenue.

• You can sit with a CISO, CTO, security architect, platform engineer, and AI-platform leader and earn credibility.

• You understand enough security architecture to reason about identity, delegated authority, credentials, policy,

enforcement, trust boundaries, auditability, and blast radius.

• You are comfortable selling before there is a polished playbook and learning directly from rejection.

• You treat AI as operating leverage. Your instinct is to build agentic workflows before asking for headcount.

• You are analytical enough to distinguish activity from evidence and evidence from causality.

• You are comfortable challenging the CEO and product assumptions when customer evidence disagrees.

Strong Background Signals

• Early-stage Zero Trust, identity, cloud security, developer security, infrastructure security, AI security, developer infrastructure, or adjacent enterprise-security categories.

• Founder, first-GTM, product-led commercial operator, technical seller, or hands-on GTM executive backgrounds can all fit.

• Large-company titles alone are not compelling.

Anti-Profile

• Your first answer to a growth problem is "hire a team."

• You depend on agencies for core positioning or customer discovery.

• You optimize lead volume before proving deployment and retention.

• You cannot personally run technical discovery or executive selling.

• You treat AI as a copywriting assistant rather than an operating system.

• You blur probabilistic AI recommendations with authorization or security enforcement.

First 90 Days: Window Expected outcome

• 0-30 days: 10-15 qualified ICP conversations; ~5 credible design-partner candidates; evidence-backed recommendation on ICP, problem, buyer, positioning, and wedge.

• 31-60 days: Convert the strongest partners into real or production-like deployments; measure time-to-value, blockers, security objections, and willingness to pay.

• 61-90 days: Target 5+ production or production-intent deployments where product readiness permits; first paying customers; prove or disprove repeatability with a second cohort; document the acquisition/onboarding motion.

How Success Is Measured

• Business: paid customers, initial ARR/MRR, expansion and eventually defensible unit economics.

• Customer: time-to-first-value, production activation, repeated authorized usage, protected resources/principals,

retention and expansion.

• Funnel: qualified conversations -> design partners -> deployments -> production -> paid -> expansion.

• Learning velocity: experiment cycle time, evidence quality, speed at which weak assumptions are killed or corrected.

Operating Model and Reporting

This role works directly with the CEO during zero-to-one discovery and partners closely with Rod, Head of Growth.

Decision rights will be explicit: CipherScale market discovery cannot become an overlapping second growth

organization, and OpenVPN growth priorities cannot dilute CipherScale category discovery. As the motion becomes

repeatable, responsibilities can be consolidated based on evidence rather than titles.

Security Expectations

You will operate with customer and prospect data, AI agents, email/CRM systems, call transcripts, and potentially

technical environments. Treat agents as potentially compromised actors. Use scoped identities, least privilege,

deterministic authorization for external actions, credential isolation, customer-data boundaries, prompt-injection

defenses, audit trails, and human approval for high-impact commitments until explicitly delegated.

Compensation Philosophy

We would rather pay exceptional compensation and meaningful upside for one outstanding founder-level operator

than assemble a large conventional GTM organization. Final structure should reflect experience, location, scope, and

demonstrated ability to create zero-to-one enterprise value.

The Test

A strong candidate should be able to take the Cipherscale thesis, identify the first market to attack, design the first ten

customer experiments, explain what evidence would invalidate the strategy, and show how they would use AI to

execute the work with minimal human headcount.

title: Principal Product Manager - Personalization
description:
The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we’re behind some of Spotify’s most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you’ll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them.

Spotify Search handles billions of queries across every market, language, and content type — music, podcasts, audiobooks, videos, playlists, and more. We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead the Search Personalization within our Conversation Product Area, setting the product strategy for how hundreds of millions of users find and discover content on Spotify. This is a leadership role at the intersection of search systems, AI, and user experience. You’ll own the end-to-end strategy for search results — from ranking and relevance to AI-powered features like semantic search, LLM reranking, and AI Overviews — while leading two key Search squads (results ranking and query suggestions). Search is the front door to Spotify; this role shapes what people find when they walk through it.

What You'll Do
  • Set the product strategy and multi-cycle roadmap for Search Personalization at Spotify — spanning ranking, relevance, retrieval, AI-native features, quality, and trust.
  • Drive the evolution of Search toward AI-native experiences — AI Overviews, semantic search, LLM reranking — balancing innovation velocity with quality and cost discipline.
  • Own the Search quality bar: define how relevance, trust, compliance, and user experience connect into a holistic quality framework with measurable outcomes.
  • Manage Search’s role as a shared surface across many company strategies — build prioritization frameworks, communicate trade-offs, and represent Search at executive forums.
  • Influence and coach junior PMs working in Search.
  • Partner with engineering leadership to make architectural decisions that balance short-term delivery with long-term Search infrastructure health.
  • Drive cross-functional alignment where Search intersects.

    • Who You Are
  • You have 8+ years of product management experience, with 3+ years leading search, discovery, or information retrieval products at scale (100M+ users).
  • You have a deep technical understanding of search systems — ranking architectures, retrieval strategies, evaluation methodology, and the trade-offs between relevance, latency, cost, and freshness.
  • You have experience with AI/ML-powered search features — semantic search, LLM-based reranking, recommendations, or similar — and can lead a team through the transition from traditional to AI-native search.
  • You have a track record of managing complex stakeholder landscapes with competing priorities and limited resources, and can build frameworks for principled prioritization.
  • You think strategically at the portfolio level — you can synthesize across many concurrent initiatives, set a coherent vision, and communicate it clearly to executives.
  • You communicate with clarity and conviction, with the ability to translate technical complexity into compelling narratives for leadership, bet owners, and cross-functional partners.
  • You have experience mentoring and developing early-career PMs, and can influence without authority or direct reporting lines.
  • You bring familiarity with music, audio, or media technology and understand the unique dynamics of content-rich platforms.
  • You have experience operating Search as a platform that serves multiple internal teams or content verticals.
  • You have worked in content integrity, trust & safety, or regulatory compliance in the context of search or discovery systems.

    • Where You'll Be
  • This role is based in London or Stockholm.
  • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.
    • Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
     
    At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.
